stronger_left_out.name: The Bend Motorsport Park
stronger_left_out.reason: two judges split: reject (A motorsport circuit sold as paid driver experiences, karting and ticketed race events (Wikipedia-high views come from e) vs keep (The Bend Motorsport Park at Tailem Bend (not Adelaide/Salisbury, which is Wikivoyage's misfiling). SA Tourism's Tailem B)

stronger_left_out.name: Pinnaroo
stronger_left_out.reason: Mallee town whose sources name only the Mallee Tourist and Heritage Centre; attraction, not the town, would be the spot (not listed here). Wrapper town.

stronger_left_out.name: Camp Coorong
stronger_left_out.reason: For: the Murray River tourism history page names Camp Coorong for immersive Ngarrindjeri cultural experiences, and it has a museum (baskets, boomerangs, photos). Against: it is run as a group cultural-education camp, and Wikipedia says it was officially closed to the public in 2018; current public access unconfirmed.

stronger_left_out.name: Murray Mouth
stronger_left_out.reason: The visitor viewpoint Wikivoyage names (Murray Mouth Lookout, Sugars Ave) is on Hindmarsh Island, in sa-fleurieu per the region lines; the mouth is not a separate visitor point in this region.

stronger_left_out.name: Swan Reach
stronger_left_out.reason: Town wrapper; its attractions (Swan Reach and District Museum, Swan Reach Observatory, Swan Reach Conservation Park) are listed separately by SATC.

stronger_left_out.name: Blanchetown
stronger_left_out.reason: For: southaustralia.com Riverland pages name Hunter Road Lookout over Lock 1 and the township, and the lock/old bridge with pelicans is a recommended photo stop. Against: the town itself has little more than a hotel and caravan park; the lookout is a short stop and likely its own candidate.

stronger_left_out.name: Clayton Bay
stronger_left_out.reason: Shack settlement; searched, no counted visitor source (Wikipedia only).

stronger_left_out.name: Wellington
stronger_left_out.reason: Searched southaustralia.com, themurrayriver.com, Wikivoyage: the only draw named is the free river ferry (transport, not a place); the old court house is now accommodation. No counted source names something to see or do.

stronger_left_out.name: Paringa
stronger_left_out.reason: Wikivoyage covers Paringa inside its Renmark article: a narrow 1927 bridge with a shared path and a small museum open three days a week 10-3. Too thin for its own spot; the town is part of Renmark's coverage.

stronger_left_out.name: Tintinara
stronger_left_out.reason: Town whose source names only a craft and produce stop (Heart of the Parks): a shop. Wrapper.

stronger_left_out.name: Younghusband Peninsula
stronger_left_out.reason: Duplicate: it is the Coorong National Park ocean-beach dune strip (Coorong NP / 42 Mile Crossing / Ninety Mile Beach cover it).

stronger_left_out.name: Cadell
stronger_left_out.reason: Wikivoyage mentions Cadell only as the proposed start of the Murray Coorong Trail (unbuilt); no source names anything to see at the township.

stronger_left_out.name: Younghusband
stronger_left_out.reason: Locality whose See&Do listings are houseboat/cruise operators; not a place to visit.

stronger_left_out.name: Loveday
stronger_left_out.reason: A locality; the visitable thing is the Loveday Internment Collection (SATC Barmera page), which is its own place. Internment camp site itself has little to see.

stronger_left_out.name: Monash
stronger_left_out.reason: Small town; its draw is the adventure park, which is the spot (town as wrapper). No counted source for the town itself.

stronger_left_out.name: Salt Creek
stronger_left_out.reason: A roadhouse settlement; Coorong NP page lists it as the start of the walking trails, which are separate candidates (Nukan Kungun Hike, Ngrugie Ngoppun, Lakes Nature Walk). Duplicate of those, nothing else to see.

stronger_left_out.name: Nildottie
stronger_left_out.reason: River-shack locality; single operator listing only, no place to see.

stronger_left_out.name: Glossop
stronger_left_out.reason: Riverland locality; no counted source found (Wikipedia only).

stronger_left_out.name: Punyelroo Cave
stronger_left_out.reason: Searched: no counted visitor source (Wikipedia, geocaching, caravan park); access via unlocked gate on steep cliff track, informal; not a managed visitor site.

stronger_left_out.name: Narrung
stronger_left_out.reason: Small settlement and ferry crossing; the draw is the Lake Albert loop and Raukkan, which are separate entries. Wrapper town.

stronger_left_out.name: Cobdogla
stronger_left_out.reason: For: southaustralia.com names the Cobdogla Irrigation and Steam Museum (world-famous Humphrey pump, steam train ride, accredited railway). Against: volunteer-run with 'five major operating days each year' and the Humphrey Pump is under repair, so it is not reliably open when a visitor arrives. Name is the locality; the museum is the place.

stronger_left_out.name: Paringa Bridge
stronger_left_out.reason: For: Wikivoyage See entry, 1927 heritage bridge with a shared walk/cycle path over the Murray. Against: single source, a walk across is short and Wikivoyage itself calls the path infrastructure questionable.

stronger_left_out.name: Mypolonga
stronger_left_out.reason: Irrigation village; no counted source; the Revolution Motor Museum is its draw (separate candidate if any).

stronger_left_out.name: Mundoo Island
stronger_left_out.reason: Private working station; its own site says no public access to the island.

stronger_left_out.name: Lyrup
stronger_left_out.reason: Village; only counted source is the Riverland Wine Centre (separate candidate/cellar-door). No town draw of its own found.

strongest_outsiders.name: Milang
strongest_outsiders.reason: Across Lake Alexandrina, about 41 km from Murray Bridge and 45 km from Meningie, reached via Strathalbyn and Goolwa; outside both spans.

strongest_outsiders.name: Swan Reach Observatory
strongest_outsiders.reason: Swan Reach is about 45 km from Mannum and beyond Mannum's 30 km reach; 'Swan Reach' is an administrative/locality label, not a destination name.

strongest_outsiders.name: River Murray International Dark Sky Reserve
strongest_outsiders.reason: Region-wide designation centred on Swan Reach, beyond Mannum's reach.

strongest_outsiders.name: Big Bend (Walker Flat)
strongest_outsiders.reason: Between Mannum and Swan Reach, beyond Mannum's reach.

strongest_outsiders.name: Shell Hill Reserve
strongest_outsiders.reason: Location unverified; likely near Swan Reach, beyond any span. Check coordinates at the pin stage.

benchmark: Region has no NZ benchmark places. Coorong ocean-beach is placed once (Ninety Mile Beach (Coorong), Younghusband Peninsula rejected as its duplicate). Lowest kept have 0 page views and 1 counted source (no Wikipedia article); every candidate left out with views above that is shown, each with its judge's concrete 'What qualifies' reason (wrapper town, locality, event/vehicle, private, no counted source, or review held for the owner). Only the top 25 by views are listed; all others rejected or review with views >0 are weaker and share the same reasons in verdicts.json.
notes: Pinnaroo, The Bend Motorsport Park, Camp Coorong, Blanchetown, Cobdogla, Paringa Bridge, Calperum Station and the Lavender Federation Trail (home elsewhere) are reviews or rejects held for the owner.
